== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1263_9</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 3-09), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-09-Guild_Of_Assassins.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-guildofassassins-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Guild Of Assassins (V)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aura, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1263_9</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 3-09, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-09-Guild_Of_Assassins-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B26 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
